{{Top}}
'''Class Four infractions''' were one of the five categories of crime outlined in the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] alongside [[Class Five infraction/Legends|Class Five]], [[Class Three infraction/Legends|Class Three]], [[Class Two infraction/Legends|Class Two]] and [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One]] infractions.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Crimes in this category included, but were not limited to: 
*Import or export of any form of narcotic without a permit
*Unregulated transport of goods that require a fee or permit to be purchased
*Failure to produce the operating license of either a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] or a ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] when questioned by Imperial authority
*Failure to produce either the [[ID profile]] of a ship or the [[Identichip/Legends|ID number]] of a ship's captain when questioned by Imperial authority

Standard Imperial punishment for this type of violation ranged from fines of 1.000 up to 5.000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and sometimes a short [[Prison/Legends|jail]] sentence for the main offender. In case a starship crew was found guilty of a Class Four infraction, the starship's owner or [[Captain/Legends|captain]] is typically considered the main offender.<ref name="GG6.2e">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)]]</ref>
